description: Free validation API for the FCC Upper C-band Clearinghouse: send one claim or a batch of up to 100 (claims: [...]), lump sum elections (kind=lumpsum: claimant_name, call_sign, site_id, antennas 'ID=qty|ID=qty', antenna_type, mvpd_site) and radio altimeter rebates (kind=altimeter: claimant_name, n_number, radio_altimeters, retrofit_type, trustee_certification, optional serial) mixed. Runs the same 24 rules as the Tensorust Clearinghouse Console against the Oct 15 2026 incumbent list (DA 26-1126), the 2020 and 2025 lists, Form 323 control groups, OFAC, the preliminary Cost Catalog (DA 26-1049), the FAA Aircraft Registry and the proposed altimeter amounts (DA 26-1076). Duplicate rules compare the claims in the call with each other. Returns per claim the verdict (accepted / review / rejected), the amount, and every rule hit with its reason and the record compared, plus totals and hits per rule. all=true adds the passing rules. Nothing is stored. Limit: 30 calls a minute and 2,000 claims an hour per IP.

all.description: true also returns the rules that passed

name: clearinghouse_validate
title: Validate Upper C-band clearinghouse claims (free)
